subject: Business Models
title: The Passion Economy
description: A quick, practical guide to The Passion Economy.

hook.text: A calligrapher earns $300K/year on Etsy. A teacher makes $500K selling courses on Teachable. Niches are the new jobs.

buildup.text: The passion economy lets individuals monetize unique skills through platforms that handle payments and distribution.

discovery.text: Unlike gig economy commoditized labor, passion economy workers differentiate on uniqueness and personal brand.

twist.text: Success in the passion economy follows a power law: the top 1% earn most of the money. Most earn very little.

climax.text: The passion economy is real but unevenly distributed. Platforms enable stars, not average participants.

punchline.text: $300K from calligraphy, $500K from teaching. Passion pays for the top 1%.

quiz.question: How does the passion economy differ from the gig economy?
options: Workers differentiate on unique skills and personal brand, not commoditized labor
